title: The Southwest swing sound and standardizing the format
summary: The band never called itself a swing band. Parker says its Southwest swing had its own rhythm, closer to New Orleans than Goodman, and arrangements were making the style standard.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
